Last SMS Dispatched: "Application forward to Latehar DWO on 14 Oct 2026"
• Nominees have strictly read-only status access. They cannot change bank accounts or revoke scholarship terms.
• All guardian accesses are logged in the immutable MoTA audit ledger with SHA-256 timestamping.
• Scholars may revoke guardian authorization at any time with instantaneous revocation propagation.
• Consent expires automatically after 365 days unless explicitly renewed.
